notes.title: THE THUG IS BACK!
notes.content:
Hello, fellow gopis and skoofs!.
We continue our series of meme games.

Gopnik will return in a new project as an antagonist!.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3144640

This time you will play as Scoof, working in a factory and playing tanks. And also he will bring order to the neighborhood and show the gopniks where the crayfish winter!

You are waiting for new memes, various references to the modern realities of our lives, as well as a lot of fun and ultra realistic graphics as in your life!

The game will also have 2 endings and even a small story.

Add the game to your vishlists and don't leave the developers without a doshik!

[previewyoutube=eaYxHgta6PQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: G.O.P.O.TA mini-game patch + DFN on the garbage cans + chickens :-)
notes.content:
Greetings to all players of our game G.O.P.O.T.A!

Releasing a small mini-patch, which fixes some minor points in the game.

And also added the ability to chase chickens - they run away from us when we approach them. As in real life!

Well, and added the blogger's logo DFN on the trash cans (he wanted it himself :-)) + his own logo in the graffiti.

Don't forget to add "Russian Village Simulator" game to your vishlists 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455370.

It will be the main character of the current game and his friend Sergei! But already as secondary characters.

notes.title: DLC "G.O.P.O.T.A.: Adventures on the railway station" release
notes.content:
Hello, dear friends!
Today we're releasing DLC - Adventures on the Train Station https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416750!

DLC turned out pretty big and weighs as much as the original game. This DLC added a number of new mechanics, three endings and new achievements, some of which were added at your request.

According to our data, more than 1500 people returned, although the guys played the game, probably passed it and still returned the money - as much as 25 rubles. This money would be enough to make the game much better than it is at the moment.

We are ready to further refine the game, exactly this DLC, but it all depends on you.
Thank you very much for your engagement and for being with us and giving this game a chance!

P.S. since the release date we have been working 24/7 on the DLC, answering your questions and patching the main version of the game.

Instructions for installing the DLC:.
1. Click the right button on the game, select the tab "Properties->Advanced Content". tick the box and you will start downloading DLC.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43958505/a0d31907ee7a8110b562a284c0c3c006b44bf3cb.jpg
2. The DLC itself is in the game folder. Steam does not create a shortcut for the game, so you will need to do this yourself if necessary.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43958505/0289811190d8cca2d6f4401370c618ea0c2f790a.jpg

notes.title: G.O.P.O.T.A. Micro Patch + 1 achievement!
notes.content:
A small patch got the following list of changes:
1. DirectX is set to default, previously only DirectX 12 was installed. Now performance on some graphics cards should be higher.
2. When we hit the kid with a stick on the street - we will immediately be added to the inventory phone. Now there is no need to pick it up. Previously there could be a bug because of this lifting.
3. Checked the trash cans after we set them on fire: only the trash disappears, not the cans themselves.

We were told that they tested the game on Steam Deck: on it the game runs at 30 FPS.

P.S. we listen to what players say and make adjustments to the game. 
Thank you all for playing our game and giving us your feedback.

notes.title: Big patch + new achievements!
notes.content:
Greetings to all players!

We have made the following changes and improvements to the game:
1. The TV in our apartment should now be triggered the first time.
2.	We have added a Respawn button to the game's pause menu if you suddenly fall somewhere under the landscape or get stuck in textures. 
3.	Increased the speed of twisting bulbs, corrected the task with them.
4.	Changed idle animation of the character. Now he is not spinning in different directions.
5.	Sometimes when picking up the phone, the character could not rotate - fixed. Previously, this bug was automatically corrected by pressing the left mouse button.
6.	Some of the vegetation had disabled shadows. FPS should go up a little.
7.	Increased a little bit the font size in the game menu.
8.	Recompiled shaders for SM5, instead of SM6, possibly artifacts on AMD video cards will be less.
9.	Now you can put or take off socks on the letter N of the game character :-)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43958505/5e2d06b1f307b87539c53df7a63a9e0cc91dc5d5.jpg
10.	 Returned the girl (or rather girls, they are randomly set at the start of the game), but now it has a little different functionality.
11.	 Added a new secret ending. Do not say what :-). Guess :-)
12.	 Added 3 new achievements: for balloons (they need to be launched), a girl and a new secret ending.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43958505/9623828b939152ec19e68eee2144ac60f2abeb0f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43958505/354dd14c942b18d0cdaafa4d61f5e75a6089942d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43958505/95faa0a0bcd221b192f3a4f1477dfec4a9538c0d.png
13.	 Removed the cherry seven music, leaving only the phrase.
14.	 Other minor fixes and improvements.

We're waiting for your suggestions and comments on the game.

And we also started working on a cool new add-on!
